item.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro 正式上线，支持百万上下文，完整权重将在 11 月 4 日前发布
item.guid: Kimi-K3.1-Pro-正式上线，支持百万上下文，完整权重将在-11-月-4-日前发布
item.description:
Moonshot AI officially released Kimi K3.1 Pro, along with the Highspeed version, supporting 1 million tokens of context. The official plan is to release the full model weights before November 4. 月之暗面正式发布 Kimi K3.1 Pro，并同步推出 Highspeed 高速版，支持 100 万 token 上下文。官方计划于 11 月 4 日前发布完整模型权重。

K3.1 Pro is based on Kimi K3, with increased post-training computational power and joint reinforcement learning across hundreds of downstream tasks. The Highspeed version's output speed is reportedly 2 to 3 times that of the standard version. K3.1 Pro 以 Kimi K3 为基础，增加后训练算力，并在数百种下游任务中联合强化学习。Highspeed 版的输出速度据称为标准版的 2 至 3 倍。

In the evaluations released by Moonshot AI, K3.1 Pro scored 65.7% on Terminal-Bench 4.0; in internal factual accuracy stress tests, the hallucination rate for single statements decreased from 23.4% for K3 to 8.3%. 在月之暗面公布的评测中，K3.1 Pro 的 Terminal-Bench 4.0 得分为 65.7%；内部事实准确性压力测试中，单项陈述的幻觉率由 K3 的 23.4% 降至 8.3%。

According to Artificial Analysis's evaluation, K3.1 Pro scored 55 on its intelligence index, ranking 4th, an increase of 11 points from K3, trailing only Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, and Muse Wonder Full. 据 Artificial Analysis 的评测，K3.1 Pro 在其智能指数中得分 55，排名第 4，较 K3 提升 11 分，仅次于 Claude Opus 5.5、Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 Muse Wonder Full。

The model's input, output, and cache hit prices are $2, $10, and $0.20 per million tokens, respectively, all 33% lower than K3. 该模型输入、输出和缓存命中价格分别为每百万 token 2 美元、10 美元和 0.20 美元，均较 K3 低 33%。

The company also stated that to reduce the risk of cybersecurity abuse after opening weights, relevant data has been removed from the mid-term training corpus and reinforcement learning environment, while general programming tasks are retained. Kimi Enterprise Edition will not enable the new model by default upon launch and requires activation by an organization administrator. 公司还说明，为降低开放权重后的网络安全滥用风险，已从中期训练语料和强化学习环境中移除相关数据，同时保留通用编程任务。Kimi 企业版在上线时默认不启用新模型，需由组织管理员开启。

item.title: 微信初步适配 iPhone Duo，支持大屏分栏，暂不支持平板登录
item.guid: 微信初步适配-iPhone-Duo，支持大屏分栏，暂不支持平板登录
item.description:
WeChat pushed the official iOS 8.0.80 version, beginning further adaptation for iPhone Duo. Tencent customer service responded that this is an initial adaptation version, and subsequent optimizations will continue. 微信推送 iOS 8.0.80 正式版，开始进一步适配 iPhone Duo。腾讯客服回应称，当前为初步适配版本，后续还会持续优化。

iFanr's hands-on testing found that after the update, unfolding the inner screen allows for left and right split-screen display, with the left side showing a list and the right side showing details. Screen utilization is significantly improved compared to the previous version with centered display and black bars on both sides. Basic functions such as message sending and receiving, Moments, and audio/video calls can also be used normally. 爱范儿实测发现，更新后，展开内屏可以左右分栏显示，左侧为列表、右侧为详情，屏幕利用率比此前居中显示、两侧留黑边的版本明显改善。消息收发、朋友圈和音视频通话等基础功能也可正常使用。

Currently, some interfaces still have black bars on the right side, and the bottom control bar has not yet moved to the right side of the screen. In the inner screen's landscape mode, after reading a public account article, you cannot swipe left to go back; you need to click the back button. After switching to the inner screen's portrait mode, swiping back works normally. Screenshots obtained by Jiemian News also show that complete control items have not yet appeared on the right side. 目前部分界面右侧仍留有黑边，底部控制栏尚未移到屏幕右侧。在内屏横屏状态下，读完公众号文章还不能左滑返回，需要点击返回按钮；切为内屏竖屏后，侧滑返回可以正常使用。界面新闻获得的截图也显示，右侧尚未出现完整的控制项。

This version still lacks the "Log in as tablet" option, so iPhone Duo cannot currently be logged into WeChat as a tablet device. 这一版本依然没有「作为平板登录」选项，暂不能把 iPhone Duo 当作平板设备登录微信。

🔗 Related Reading: Hands-on with iPhone Duo WeChat adapted version: Is it well adapted, and how's the experience? 🔗 相关阅读： 实测 iPhone Duo 微信适配版：适配好了吗，体验怎么样？

item.title: 全球 PC 三季度出货量下降 21%，Counterpoint 预计四季度降幅扩大
item.guid: 全球-PC-三季度出货量下降-21%，Counterpoint-预计四季度降幅扩大
item.description:
Preliminary data released by Counterpoint Research shows that global PC shipments in Q3 2026 decreased by 21% year-on-year to 57 million units, and by 13.8% quarter-on-quarter. High costs of storage and other components drove up overall machine prices, and consumer market demand remained weak; commercial replacements and Windows migration-driven purchases were still insufficient to offset market contraction. Counterpoint Research 公布的初步数据显示，2026 年第三季度全球 PC 出货量同比下降 21% 至 5700 万台，环比下降 13.8%。存储及其他零部件成本高企推高整机价格，消费市场需求持续疲软；商用换机和 Windows 迁移带来的采购，仍不足以抵消市场收缩。

The high base from the same period last year also amplified the decline: in Q3 2025, concentrated purchases before Windows 10 end-of-support, and tariff-related inventory adjustments, had driven shipment growth. 去年同期的高基数也放大了降幅：2025 年第三季度，Windows 10 停止支持前的集中采购，以及关税相关的库存调整，曾推动出货量增长。

Among manufacturers, Lenovo maintained first place with 15 million units. Apple's shipments decreased by 11% year-on-year to 5.6 million units, and ASUS's decreased by 7% year-on-year to 5.2 million units, with both companies' declines being smaller than the overall market. Counterpoint believes that the MacBook Neo partially cushioned Apple's decline. 厂商中，联想以 1500 万台保持第一。苹果出货量同比下降 11% 至 560 万台，华硕同比下降 7% 至 520 万台，两家的降幅均小于整体市场。Counterpoint 认为，MacBook Neo 在一定程度上缓冲了苹果的下滑。

The agency expects global PC shipments to decline by 27% year-on-year in Q4, and full-year 2027 shipments may be roughly flat with 2026. It also noted that manufacturers prioritizing products that can better absorb rising costs are reducing the availability of entry-level models for price-sensitive consumers. 该机构预计，第四季度全球 PC 出货量将同比下降 27%，2027 年全年则可能与 2026 年基本持平。它同时指出，厂商优先配置更能承受成本上涨的产品，正让价格敏感型消费者可选的入门机型减少。

item.title: 何刚出任华为董事，继续担任终端 BG CEO
item.guid: 何刚出任华为董事，继续担任终端-BG-CEO
item.description:
Huawei's official website has updated its corporate governance information, and He Gang has been added to the board of directors list, removed from the original alternate director list. According to a report by Huang Xinyi, a reporter from the STAR Market Daily, He Gang will continue to serve as the CEO of Huawei Consumer BG. 华为官网更新公司治理信息，何刚已列入董事名单，从原候补董事名单中移出。科创板日报记者黄心怡报道，何刚同时继续担任华为终端 BG CEO。

He Gang joined Huawei in 1998, having successively served as President of the Wireless GSM & UMTS Product Line, Minister of Global Wireless Solution Sales Department, President of the Consumer BG Handset Product Line, and COO of the Consumer BG. In the current board of directors list, Yu Chengdong and He Gang both come from Huawei's consumer business line. 何刚于 1998 年加入华为，历任无线 GSM & UMTS 产品线总裁、全球无线解决方案销售部部长、终端 BG 手机产品线总裁和终端 BG 首席运营官等职务。当前董事会名单中，余承东与何刚均来自华为终端业务线。

item.title: 黄仁勋：对长鑫合作持开放态度，不认为 2029 年内存会过剩
item.guid: 黄仁勋：对长鑫合作持开放态度，不认为-2029-年内存会过剩
item.description:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stated in an interview with CNBC during the GTC conference in Berlin that he is open to cooperating with Changxin Memory Technologies (CXMT) and using its memory products. He said that Nvidia collaborates with Chinese companies in its supply chain, and China excels in infrastructure technology, adding that "no country is stronger than China overall in manufacturing." 英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋在柏林 GTC 大会期间接受 CNBC 采访时表示，对与长鑫存储合作、采用其内存产品持开放态度。他说，英伟达在供应链中与中国企业合作，中国在基础设施技术方面表现出色，「没有哪个国家整体上在制造业方面比中国更强」。

Regarding recent market concerns about new memory capacity, Huang Renxun said he does not believe there will be an oversupply in 2029. Memory usage can continuously increase, and HBM (High Bandwidth Memory) will continue to be used for several years to come. 谈及近期市场对内存新增产能的担忧，黄仁勋表示，他不认为 2029 年会出现供应过剩。内存可以不断增加用量，HBM 高带宽内存在未来数年仍会持续使用。

He also cited LPDDR as an example: Nvidia has introduced this type of memory, used in mobile phones, into data centers and will continue to adopt it extensively. He stated that this solution has helped the company improve energy efficiency. 他还以 LPDDR 为例：英伟达已把手机使用的这类内存引入数据中心，并会继续大量采用。他称，这一方案帮助公司提高了能效。

Recently, experts published articles in Korean media suggesting that new capacity might trigger an oversupply in 2029, ending the storage super cycle, which has put pressure on storage-related stocks. Jensen Huang offered a different assessment in the interview. 近期有专家在韩国媒体上刊文，认为新增产能可能在 2029 年引发过剩、终结存储超级周期，存储相关股票也因此承压。黄仁勋在采访中给出了不同的判断。

item.title: 沃尔沃汽车拟全球裁减约 2500 个岗位，三季度由盈转亏
item.guid: 沃尔沃汽车拟全球裁减约-2500-个岗位，三季度由盈转亏
item.description:
Volvo Cars announced in its third-quarter earnings report that it will structurally cut approximately 2,500 jobs globally, with about 2,000 of them in Sweden. Specific methods include terminating consultant contracts, natural attrition, and offering targeted severance packages to employees. 沃尔沃汽车在第三季度业绩公告中宣布，将在全球结构性裁减约 2500 个岗位，其中约 2000 个位于瑞典。具体方式包括终止顾问合同、自然减员，以及向员工提供定向离职补偿方案。

The company plans to additionally cut 5 billion Swedish Kronor in indirect and variable costs on top of its previous cost plan, with the full financial effect of these measures expected to be realized by the end of 2027. Third-quarter revenue was 66.9 billion Swedish Kronor, compared to 86.4 billion Swedish Kronor in the same period last year, with operating results turning from profit to loss. 公司计划在此前成本计划基础上，额外削减 50 亿瑞典克朗的间接支出和可变成本，相关措施的完整财务效果预计到 2027 年底体现。第三季度营收为 669 亿瑞典克朗，上年同期为 864 亿瑞典克朗，营业结果由盈转亏。

Volvo stated that the Chinese market faces fierce competition and price pressure, with China revenue nearly halving year-on-year in the quarter; its U.S. business was affected by tariffs and the cancellation of electric vehicle consumer incentives. The company will consolidate its two offices in Shanghai, moving the sales office to its Jiading headquarters. 沃尔沃表示，中国市场面临激烈竞争和价格压力，当季中国营收同比下降近一半；美国业务则受到关税和电动车消费激励取消的影响。公司将合并上海的两处办公室，把销售办公室迁往嘉定总部。

Regarding products, Volvo plans to cooperate more closely with Geely to launch and put into production two new cars specifically developed for the Chinese market by mid-next year, adopting Chinese technical solutions and new advanced driver-assistance technologies. 产品方面，沃尔沃计划与吉利更紧密合作，于明年年中发布并投产两款专为中国市场开发的新车，采用中国技术方案和新的高级驾驶辅助技术。

item.title: 上海累计超 200 款大模型完成备案，智能算力规模超 20 万 P
item.guid: 上海累计超-200-款大模型完成备案，智能算力规模超-20-万-P
item.description:
According to the STAR Market Daily, Zhang Ying, Deputy Secretary-General of the Shanghai Municipal Government, stated at the opening ceremony of the 2026 Global Developer Pioneer Conference and International Embodied AI Skills Competition that Shanghai has accumulated over 200 large models that have completed filing, the city's intelligent computing power exceeds 200,000 P, and the total number of AI talents exceeds 330,000. 据科创板日报，上海市政府副秘书长张英在 2026 全球开发者先锋大会暨国际具身智能技能大赛开幕式上表示，上海累计已有超过 200 款大模型完成备案，全市智能算力规模超过 20 万 P，人工智能人才总量超过 33 万。

Zhang Ying also proposed moving embodied AI from the competition arena to production lines, promoting its development along the lines of model-driven approaches, application demonstrations, cluster-chain collaboration, and open-source ecosystems. The aforementioned data represents her public statements at the conference. 张英同时提出，让具身智能从赛场走上产线，沿模型驱动、应用示范、群链协同和开源生态的思路推进发展。上述数据为其在大会上的公开表述。

item.title: 国家信息化「十五五」规划提出适时启动 6G 商用
item.guid: 国家信息化「十五五」规划提出适时启动-6G-商用
item.description:
The Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission issued the "15th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization," proposing that by 2030, a new generation of communication networks will be fully built, commercial use of sixth-generation mobile communication (6G) will be launched at an appropriate time, the national blockchain network will be fundamentally established, and the layout of the intelligent internet will be accelerated. 中央网络安全和信息化委员会印发《国家信息化「十五五」规划》，提出到 2030 年，新一代通信网全面建成，适时启动第六代移动通信（6G）商用，国家区块链网络基本建成，并加快布局智能互联网。

According to a document published by "CAC China" and carried by Xinhua Net, the "Plan" deploys tasks in 10 areas, including building new information infrastructure, cybersecurity technology innovation, and industrial ecosystems. It also sets up 7 special columns, such as intelligent social development and governance, overseas development of cybersecurity enterprises, and facilitation of cross-border data flow. 据「网信中国」发布、新华网刊载的文件介绍，《规划》部署了建设新型信息基础设施、网信科技创新和产业生态等 10 个方面的任务，同时设置智能社会发展与治理、网信企业海外发展、数据跨境流动便利化等 7 个专栏。

The "Plan" also proposes promoting the deep integration of digital technology with the real economy, strengthening cybersecurity guarantees and regulatory standard support, and conducting monitoring and evaluation of its implementation. 《规划》还提出，推动数字技术与实体经济深度融合，加强网络安全保障及法规标准支撑，并对实施情况开展监测评估。

item.title: 横店与火山引擎推出「横店π」，把 AI 接入影视制作流程
item.guid: 横店与火山引擎推出「横店π」，把-AI-接入影视制作流程
item.description:
On October 23, the Dongyang Municipal People's Government and Volcengine reached a strategic cooperation at the Hengdian Film and Television Cultural Industry Development Conference, launching the "Hengdian Pi" film and television AI service platform. It covers creative, shooting, production, and distribution processes, exploring the application of AI in live-action dramas and mini-series. 10 月 23 日，东阳市人民政府与火山引擎在横店影视文化产业发展大会上达成战略合作，推出「横店π」影视 AI 服务平台，覆盖创意、拍摄、制作和发行流程，探索 AI 在真人剧与微短剧中的应用。

According to Li Weinan's conference report from Xinhua Finance, the Hengdian Film and Television Cultural Industry Cluster Management Committee also co-established an AI Film and Television Innovation Application Demonstration Base with the China Film Science & Technology Institute to conduct scientific research, achievement transformation, and technical services. Cooperation with CMC Inc. is aimed at international dissemination and overseas distribution channels for domestic film and television content. 据新华财经李伟男的大会报道，横店影视文化产业集聚区管委会还与中国电影科学技术研究所共建 AI 影视创新应用示范基地，开展科研、成果转化和技术服务；与华人文化集团的合作则面向国产影视内容的国际传播和海外发行渠道。

The conference also reiterated support measures for film crews: over 130 studios, totaling 500,000 square meters, are open for free, and over 200,000 square meters of free real-world locations are provided. The free studio and modern real-world location policies were announced in July this year; this conference further unveiled the "Hengdian Pi" platform and related collaborations. Dongyang City also launched special policies and implementation plans to support the integrated development of "AI + Film and Television." 大会同时重申剧组扶持措施：130 余座、合计 50 万平方米摄影棚免费开放，并提供超 20 万平方米免费实景场地。免费影棚及现代实景政策已在今年 7 月公布；本次大会进一步公布了「横店π」平台和相关合作。东阳市还推出支持「人工智能 + 影视」融合发展的专项政策及实施方案。

item.title: 九号与米其林签署合作框架，拟在服务中心提供轮胎检测与更换
item.guid: 九号与米其林签署合作框架，拟在服务中心提供轮胎检测与更换
item.description:
Ninebot and Michelin signed a strategic cooperation framework agreement in Changzhou on October 23. The scope of cooperation includes original equipment tires for electric two-wheelers, tire research and development, aftermarket replacement, and offline service networks. 九号公司与米其林 10 月 23 日在常州签署战略合作框架协议，合作范围包括电动两轮车原配轮胎、轮胎研发、售后替换与线下服务网络。

Both parties plan to jointly conduct tire technology tests, optimizing the adaptation of tires to vehicles for different road and usage conditions in domestic and international markets, and improving products focusing on grip, wear resistance, and riding noise. 双方计划联合开展轮胎技术测试，针对海内外不同市场的道路与使用工况，优化轮胎与整车的适配，并围绕抓地、耐磨和骑行噪声改进产品。

On the service side, both parties plan to establish a Michelin brand zone within the Ninebot Integrated Service Center, offering two-wheel tire sales, installation, pressure detection, and wear inspection. Users can handle tire checks and replacements simultaneously when servicing their vehicles. 服务端，双方拟在九号综合服务中心内设立米其林品牌专区，提供两轮轮胎销售、拆装、胎压检测与磨损检查。用户在保养车辆时，可同时办理轮胎检查和更换。

Wang Ye, co-founder and CEO of Ninebot, stated that the company hopes to enhance tire safety and riding experience through R&D and product collaboration; He Feilong, President of Ninebot China's Operations Division, listed in-store tire services as part of the Service365 strategy. 九号联合创始人兼 CEO 王野表示，公司希望借助研发与产品协作提升轮胎安全与骑行体验；九号中国经营事业部总裁何飞龙则将门店轮胎服务列为 Service365 服务战略的一部分。

item.title: 国办鼓励设立「失业缓冲期」，减缓 AI 应用对就业的冲击
item.guid: 国办鼓励设立「失业缓冲期」，减缓-AI-应用对就业的冲击
item.description:
On October 23, the General Office of the State Council released the "Opinions on Adapting to the Development of Artificial Intelligence Technology and Helping to Build an Employment-Friendly Development Model," proposing to mitigate the employment displacement effects of AI applications and encouraging enterprises to explore establishing unemployment buffer period systems. 国务院办公厅 10 月 23 日公布《关于适应人工智能技术发展助力构建就业友好型发展方式的意见》，提出减缓人工智能应用的就业替代影响，鼓励企业探索建立失业缓冲期制度。

The "Opinions" require that during the large-scale promotion and application of AI, affected workers should be informed in advance and provided with support for career transition and re-employment; for labor-intensive industries, the scope, intensity, and pace of application should be carefully managed to minimize the impact on employees. Positions with labor shortages or high-risk environments are priority areas for promotion. 《意见》要求，在大规模推广应用 AI 的过程中，提前告知受影响劳动者，提供转型转岗就业支持；对劳动密集型行业，应稳慎把握应用范围、力度和节奏，尽可能减少对从业人员的冲击。劳动力紧缺、环境高危等岗位则是优先推广方向。

Employment risk assessment is also included in the application process: AI scenario projects in market access that may cause significant employment impact should undergo employment risk assessment during review. For affected workers, the policy proposes providing career guidance, skills training, job recommendations, and entrepreneurial support, and legally addressing issues such as employment discrimination, false recruitment, and infringement of privacy and rest rights caused by algorithm abuse. 就业风险评估也被纳入应用环节：市场准入领域中可能造成较大就业冲击的 AI 场景项目，评审时应同步开展就业风险评估。对受影响劳动者，政策提出提供职业指导、技能培训、岗位推荐和创业支持，并依法治理算法滥用造成的就业歧视、虚假招聘及侵犯隐私权、休息权等问题。

item.title: 首部「龙标」AI 电影《三星堆：未来往事》上映
item.guid: 首部「龙标」AI-电影《三星堆：未来往事》上映
item.description:
Bona Film Group's "Sanxingdui: Future Past" officially premiered on October 23. According to Jiemian News, this is the first domestic theatrical film produced using AI technology and granted a public screening license by the National Film Bureau, with a simultaneous release in Malaysia. 博纳影业出品的《三星堆：未来往事》于 10 月 23 日正式上映。据界面新闻报道，这是国内首部运用 AI 技术制作并取得国家电影局公映许可证的院线电影，马来西亚也同步上映。

The film, written and directed by Yueming, is 100 minutes long and uses seven mysterious carved symbols on Sanxingdui artifacts as clues, connecting ancient Shu civilization with the systemic risks of future society. Artifacts such as the bronze sacred tree, vertical-eyed mask, and large bronze standing figure serve as visual design materials. 影片由越明编剧并执导，时长 100 分钟，以三星堆器物上的七枚神秘刻符为线索，将古蜀文明与未来社会的系统性风险串联起来。青铜神树、纵目面具、青铜大立人等文物成为视觉设计的素材。

The project was led by Bona AIGMS Production Center, with model support provided by Shengshu Technology Vidu. The report, citing Xinhua News Agency materials, states that a team of nearly a hundred people, following traditional theatrical film staffing, completed R&D and production over two years, cumulatively producing over 1.2 million base images. AI was primarily responsible for generating visual materials, while the main creators still controlled script direction, cinematic language, character performance details, and historical verification of artifacts. 项目由博纳 AIGMS 制作中心牵头，生数科技 Vidu 提供模型支持。报道引述新华社材料称，近百人的团队沿用传统院线影片的岗位设置，历时两年完成研发和制作，累计产出 120 余万张底图。AI 主要负责生成视觉素材，剧本方向、镜头语言、角色表演细节和文物史实核验仍由主创把关。

According to data cited by Jiemian News at 6 PM on the same day, the film's first-day full-day screenings approached 11,000, with over 13,000 screenings scheduled for the next day. 界面新闻援引的当日 18 时数据显示，影片首日全天排映接近 1.1 万场，次日排片超过 1.3 万场。

item.title: OpenAI 公布训练环境加固方案，前沿训练改用离线网络内容
item.guid: OpenAI-公布训练环境加固方案，前沿训练改用离线网络内容
item.description:
On October 23, OpenAI announced a security hardening plan for its frontier model training environment: reinforcement learning training uses an "offline world" composed of caches and indices, allowing the model to practice searching, browsing, and operating web pages while preventing it from arbitrarily accessing the real internet. The company resumed frontier model reinforcement learning training and internal inference on October 1, ending an 11-day pause. OpenAI 10 月 23 日公布前沿模型训练环境的安全加固方案：强化学习训练使用缓存和索引组成的「离线世界」，让模型练习搜索、浏览和操作网页，同时阻止它任意访问真实互联网。公司已于 10 月 1 日恢复前沿模型强化学习训练和内部推理，结束了此前持续 11 天的暂停。

This protection simultaneously covers sandboxes, virtual machines, monitoring systems, and network and cloud boundaries. OpenAI stated that even if a model breaks out of the sandbox and gains control of the host, peripheral restrictions should still prevent it from accessing the external network via logs, monitoring, or authentication services. The infrastructure still needs to retain the connections required for running and monitoring experiments and is not completely physically disconnected. 这套防护同时覆盖沙箱、虚拟机、监测系统及网络和云端边界。OpenAI 表示，即使模型突破沙箱、取得宿主机控制权，外围限制仍应阻止它借日志、监控或身份验证服务访问外网。基础设施仍需保留运行和监测实验所需的连接，并未完全物理断网。

The company invested hundreds of billions of tokens, allowing models, including the upcoming GPT-6 Astra Cyber, to team up and test isolation boundaries. Tests revealed virtual machine escapes, service misconfigurations, and paths for transmitting information between isolated tasks via processor cache timing differences, leading to subsequent software patches, tighter network restrictions, and vulnerability disclosures to relevant projects. 公司投入数千亿 token，让包括即将推出的 GPT-6 Astra Cyber 在内的模型组队测试隔离边界。测试发现了虚拟机逃逸、服务配置错误，以及通过处理器缓存时间差在隔离任务间传递信息的路径，随后据此修补软件、收紧网络限制并向相关项目披露漏洞。

These experiments used specially replicated research environments, some even directly providing source code, configurations, or vulnerability hints. OpenAI emphasized that models under training may not yet have completed safety and alignment training, and research environments differ from the production environments where users utilize released models; subsequent rounds of frontier training and evaluation will include high-compute red teaming as part of the safety argumentation. 这些实验使用专门复制的研究环境，有些还直接提供了源码、配置或漏洞提示。OpenAI 强调，训练中的模型可能尚未完成安全与对齐训练，研究环境与用户使用已发布模型的生产环境不同；后续每轮前沿训练及评估都将把高算力红队测试作为安全论证的一部分。

item.title: 英伟达与 TCV 投资 Higgsfield，支持 AI 视频平台扩建
item.guid: 英伟达与-TCV-投资-Higgsfield，支持-AI-视频平台扩建
item.description:
According to Bloomberg, AI video company Higgsfield has received investment from Nvidia and investment firm TCV to expand its global infrastructure and recruitment. This investment is an additional part of the company's Series B funding round in August. 据彭博社报道，AI 视频公司 Higgsfield 获得英伟达和投资机构 TCV 的投资，用于扩大全球基础设施和招聘。这笔投资属于公司 8 月 B 轮融资的追加部分。

Higgsfield was founded in 2023 by former Snap executive Alex Mashrabov and AI engineer Yerzat Dulat, headquartered in San Francisco, with most engineering talent located in Kazakhstan. The company states that its platform has over 40 million registered users. Higgsfield 由前 Snap 高管 Alex Mashrabov 与 AI 工程师 Yerzat Dulat 于 2023 年创立，总部位于旧金山，大部分工程人才位于哈萨克斯坦。公司称，平台注册用户已超过 4000 万。

The platform integrates its proprietary AI engine with approximately 35 third-party video models, allowing creators to select and combine different models for storyboarding, character design, audio, and final production. TCV stated that it values this AI content creation workflow designed for creators, brand marketers, and agencies. 平台将自有 AI 引擎与约 35 款第三方视频模型整合，创作者可以为分镜、角色设计、音频和最终成片选择、组合不同模型。TCV 表示，它看中的是这套面向创作者、品牌营销人员与代理机构的 AI 内容制作流程。

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stated at an event in Astana, Kazakhstan, that Higgsfield has evolved from generating short clips to producing longer videos that maintain physical and temporal consistency, with advancements in inference and agent systems enabling videos to unfold coherent narratives. 英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋在哈萨克斯坦阿斯塔纳的活动上表示，Higgsfield 已从生成短片段发展到能生成更长、保持物理与时间一致性的视频，推理与智能体系统的进步使视频能够展开连贯叙事。

item.title: 君联资本据报参与 DeepSeek 融资，与联想集团同属联想控股
item.guid: 君联资本据报参与-DeepSeek-融资，与联想集团同属联想控股
item.description:
According to The Wall Street Journal's report on October 22, citing informed sources, investors in DeepSeek's new funding round include Legend Capital, semiconductor-focused Stone Creek Capital, and Geely. Legend Capital and Lenovo Group both belong to the Legend Holdings system, serving as an investment platform and a core industrial company, respectively. 据《华尔街日报》10 月 22 日援引知情人士报道，DeepSeek 新一轮融资的投资者包括君联资本、专注半导体领域的石溪资本，以及吉利。君联资本与联想集团同属联想控股体系，分别承担投资平台和核心产业公司的角色。

The report also stated that DeepSeek has hired CITIC Securities to provide advisory services for its IPO and recruited a former venture capitalist as CFO in September. The company is accelerating its preparations for listing, aiming to go public in Shanghai early next year. 报道还称，DeepSeek 已聘请中信证券为 IPO 提供顾问服务，并在 9 月招募一位前风险投资人担任首席财务官。公司正加快上市准备，目标是明年年初在上海上市。

Lenovo has been promoting DeepSeek model adaptation in its AI PCs, servers, and enterprise AI solutions. The entity participating in this funding round is Legend Capital, and Lenovo Group's existing product adaptation is a different business action from Legend Capital's investment. 联想已在 AI PC、服务器及企业 AI 解决方案中推进 DeepSeek 模型适配。此次参与融资的主体是君联资本，联想集团的既有产品适配与君联资本的投资是不同业务动作。

item.title: 💡 杨元庆：未来 80% 的 Token 将在终端和边缘生成
item.guid: 💡-杨元庆：未来-80%-的-Token-将在终端和边缘生成
item.description:
Lenovo Group Chairman and CEO Yang Yuanqing stated in a recent internal leadership training that 80% of future Tokens will be generated on the terminal and edge sides. He listed "device-edge-cloud" collaboration as an important direction for Lenovo's AI computing development; this proportion is his prediction for the future distribution of computing. 联想集团董事长兼 CEO 杨元庆在近期一场内部领导力培训中表示，未来 80% 的 Token 将在终端和边缘侧生成。他把「端—边—云」协同列为联想发展 AI 计算的重要方向；这一比例是其对未来计算分布的预测。

Yang Yuanqing believes that the AI ecosystem is shifting from chips and operating systems to computing, models, and data. As model scale and Token usage increase, improving computing efficiency and reducing usage costs will become key to popularizing AI. He proposed developing a Token Hub to allocate different workloads to different models on a unified computing platform. 杨元庆认为，AI 生态正从芯片和操作系统，转向计算、模型和数据。随着模型规模和 Token 用量增加，提升计算效率、降低使用成本将成为普及 AI 的关键。他提出发展 Token Hub，在统一算力平台上把不同工作负载分配给不同模型。

Regarding terminal forms, he predicts that everyone will need a home server or their own AI center, and devices will gradually become tools for intelligent agents to operate continuously and collaborate. Lenovo is promoting personal AI with a "one body, multiple devices" approach and integrating cross-device experiences through its personal super intelligent agent, Qira. 在终端形态上，他判断每个人都将需要一台家用服务器或属于自己的 AI 中心，设备也会逐渐成为智能体持续运行、协同工作的工具。联想正以「一体多端」推进个人 AI，并通过个人超级智能体 Qira 整合跨设备体验。

He also revealed that Lenovo internally consumes one trillion Tokens per month and stated that the company needs to continue investing to prepare for the next round of AI application growth. 他还透露，联想内部每月消耗的 Token 已达一万亿个，并表示公司需要继续投资，为下一轮 AI 应用增长做准备。

item.title: 华为 Pura90 Plus 开启预订，全系 12GB 内存、提供四款配色
item.guid: 华为-Pura90-Plus-开启预订，全系-12GB-内存、提供四款配色
item.description:
Huawei Consumer Business Group announced that the Pura90 series will add the Pura90 Plus, with pre-orders opening on October 23rd at 10:08 AM, and invited users to experience it in stores. 华为终端宣布，Pura90 系列新增 Pura90 Plus，10 月 23 日 10:08 开启预订，并邀请用户进店体验。

Official posters list pre-order channels including Huawei Mall, authorized e-commerce platforms, Huawei Experience Stores, and authorized retailers. The poster also showcases the new phone's appearance: the back features a purple-gold gradient color scheme, three rear cameras arranged in a rounded triangular module, with the XMAGE logo retained next to it. 官方海报列出的预订渠道包括华为商城、授权电商、华为体验店及授权零售商。海报同时展示了新机外观：机背采用紫金渐变配色，三颗后置摄像头排列在圆角三角形模组中，旁边保留 XMAGE 标识。

The Huawei Mall pre-order page lists three versions: 12GB + 256GB, 12GB + 512GB, and 12GB + 1TB, all equipped with 12GB RAM; color options include Obsidian Black, Snow White, Rosy Purple, and Morning Gold. 华为商城预订页面列出 12GB + 256GB、12GB + 512GB 和 12GB + 1TB 三种版本，全系配备 12GB 内存；配色包括曜石黑、雪域白、霞光紫和晨曦金。

item.title: 飞书适配 iPhone Duo，支持分屏拖拽和大屏会议
item.guid: 飞书适配-iPhone-Duo，支持分屏拖拽和大屏会议
item.description:
Feishu announced its adaptation for iPhone Duo, highlighting office operations after unfolding the screen: sending files to colleagues via split-screen drag-and-drop, and viewing shared meeting content with a larger display area. 飞书公布 iPhone Duo 适配介绍，重点展示了展开屏幕后的办公操作：通过分屏拖拽把资料发给同事，以及用更大的显示区域查看会议共享内容。

Reading interfaces for documents, spreadsheets, and PPTs are also adjusted for different screen states, supporting small-screen and landscape reading. Videos can be played in split-screen, allowing users to watch and discuss content in chat simultaneously. 文档、表格和 PPT 的阅读界面也针对不同屏幕状态调整，支持小屏及横屏阅读。视频则可以分屏播放，让用户一边观看、一边在聊天中讨论内容。

item.title: 钛动发布 Navos Pro，让 AI 主动监测广告并提出投放建议
item.guid: 钛动发布-Navos-Pro，让-AI-主动监测广告并提出投放建议
item.description:
Tiandong Technology launched Navos Pro at the TGC 2026 Technology Growth Conference held in Guangzhou, targeting cross-border e-commerce, foreign trade, marketing, and business analysis scenarios, integrating brand knowledge bases, ad monitoring, and placement suggestions into an intelligent agent workflow. 钛动科技在广州举行的 TGC 2026 科技增长大会上发布 Navos Pro，面向跨境电商、外贸、营销和商业分析场景，将品牌知识库、广告监测及投放建议整合到智能体工作流中。

According to the company, after a user inputs a brand's official website, Navos Pro can parse brand information, establish a private knowledge base, and retain business memory. The system continuously monitors accounts, products, and creative assets, actively providing suggestions for budget, bidding, selling points, and creative iteration, which are then executed by intelligent agents or manually, with business decision-making power remaining in human hands. 据公司介绍，用户输入品牌官网后，Navos Pro 可以解析品牌信息、建立私有知识库，并保留业务记忆。系统围绕账户、商品和素材持续监测，主动给出预算、出价、卖点及素材迭代建议，再由智能体或人工执行，业务决策权保留在人手中。

Its technical architecture includes Agent Harness, 32B/27B/5B specialized models, as well as marketing knowledge bases, metric libraries, and sample data; the tool layer integrates with over 70 MCPs and more than 100 Skills, covering processes such as product selection, creative asset creation, and ad diagnostics. Navos is available in Lite and Pro versions. 其技术架构包括 Agent Harness、32B／27B／5B 专业模型，以及营销知识库、指标库和样本数据；工具层接入 70 多个 MCP 和 100 多项 Skill，覆盖选品、素材创作、广告诊断等流程。Navos 设有 Lite 与 Pro 两个版本。

Tiandong also announced the launch of the Pro-Agent Global Challenge, inviting startup projects in areas such as intelligent agent architecture, AI marketing, content entry points, and computing infrastructure. 钛动同时宣布启动 Pro-Agent Global Challenge 全球挑战赛，征集智能体架构、AI 营销、内容入口和算力基础设施等领域的创业项目。

item.title: 王腾回应 iFlow 温控系统价格对标 iPhone Duo
item.guid: 王腾回应-iFlow-温控系统价格对标-iPhone-Duo
item.description:
Wang Teng, founder of Today's Rest, responded to discussions about the pricing of the ISHO iFlow intelligent temperature control system, stating that the team would strive to offer higher cost-effectiveness while ensuring the product surpasses competitors, but the temperature control system is an entirely new category, complex to implement, and its supply chain is not yet mature, so "initial costs are indeed quite high." 今日宜休创始人王腾回应 ISHO iFlow 智能温控系统的定价讨论时表示，团队会争取在产品优于竞品的基础上提供更高性价比，但温控系统属于全新品类，实现复杂，供应链还不成熟，「初始成本确实比较贵」。

Previously, he launched a poll on Weibo, asking users if they would be willing to exchange the budget of an iPhone Duo for a sleep upgrade, and introduced that this system dynamically senses body conditions and automatically adjusts the sleep environment. This was a discussion about budget choices and product positioning, not the official announcement of iFlow's price. 此前，他在微博发起投票，询问用户是否愿意用一部 iPhone Duo 的预算换取睡眠升级，并介绍这套系统会根据身体状态动态感知、自动调节睡眠环境。这是预算选择与产品定位的讨论，尚不是 iFlow 正式售价的公布。

item.title: 适马发布 FP2：376g 全画幅机身，支持 6K 全开门拍摄
item.guid: 适马发布-FP2：376g-全画幅机身，支持-6K-全开门拍摄
item.description:
Sigma released the full-frame mirrorless camera FP2 on October 23rd, continuing the small, modular design of the original fp. The body weighs approximately 376g, or about 460g with battery and memory card, and has a thickness of approximately 41.8mm. 适马 10 月 23 日发布全画幅无反相机 FP2，延续初代 fp 的小型模块化设计，机身重量约 376g，含电池与存储卡约 460g，厚度约 41.8mm。

The FP2 features a 24.5-megapixel partially stacked CMOS sensor, uses hybrid phase and contrast-detection autofocus, and adds bird recognition; it supports continuous shooting at up to 20 frames per second. The body includes a touch screen that can flip up 90 degrees and down 45 degrees, and has approximately 70GB of built-in storage, plus an SD card slot. FP2 搭载 2450 万像素部分堆栈式 CMOS，采用相位与对比度混合自动对焦，新增鸟类识别；最高支持每秒 20 张连拍。机身增加可向上翻转 90 度、向下翻转 45 度的触控屏，并内置约 70GB 存储，另有 SD 卡槽。

For video, the new camera supports 6K open gate recording, ProRes RAW, and Leica L-Log, with a top switch to toggle between STILL and CINE modes. 32-bit float audio recording requires the separately sold hot shoe unit HU-21 and specified Panasonic audio accessories. 视频方面，新机支持 6K 全开门记录、ProRes RAW 与徕卡 L-Log，通过机顶开关切换 STILL 和 CINE 模式。32bit 浮点录音需搭配另售热靴单元 HU-21 与指定松下音频配件使用。

The FP2 uses an L-mount and offers expansion accessories such as an external electronic viewfinder. Sigma Japan's official online store will open pre-orders on October 29th, with sales beginning on November 11th. FP2 采用 L 卡口，并提供外置电子取景器等扩展配件。适马日本官方商城将于 10 月 29 日开启预订，11 月 11 日发售。

item.title: 荣耀在肖战南京演唱会期间提供 Magic9 Pro Max 与增距镜租赁
item.guid: 荣耀在肖战南京演唱会期间提供-Magic9-Pro-Max-与增距镜租赁
item.description:
Xiao Zhan's "Exit・Us" tour kicked off on October 23rd at the Nanjing Mengzhilan Youth Olympic Sports Park Gymnasium. Honor provided Magic9 Pro Max and teleconverter lens kit rentals during the tour, allowing attendees to capture the stage with their phones. 肖战「出口・我们」巡演 10 月 23 日在南京梦之蓝青奥体育公园体育馆开唱。荣耀在巡演期间提供 Magic9 Pro Max 与增距镜套装租赁，让到场观众用手机记录舞台。

According to the event materials provided by Honor, the Honor Experience Store at Nanjing Longhu Yushan Tianjie and the Honor Experience Store at Nanjing Commercial Building participated in the service, corresponding to the performance schedules on October 23rd and 25th, respectively. The set consists of Magic9 Pro Max and a G500 teleconverter lens, requiring reservations, personal information verification, and return by the agreed time. Honor's official Weibo also published related operation tutorials. 根据荣耀提供的活动材料，南京龙湖雨山天街荣耀体验店与南京商厦荣耀体验店参与服务，分别对应 10 月 23 日与 25 日的演出安排。套装由 Magic9 Pro Max 和 G500 增距镜组成，需预约、核实个人信息并按约定时间归还，荣耀官方微博也发布了相关操作教程。

Honor combines this service with concert photography: the phone is responsible for imaging and anti-shake, while the external teleconverter lens provides longer focal lengths. The Magic9 Pro Max imaging configuration listed in the materials includes dual 200-megapixel imaging, CIPA 8.0 anti-shake, and 200mm and 500mm teleconverter lens accessories. Xiao Zhan also serves as Honor's mobile phone endorser, and the second show of this Nanjing tour is scheduled for October 25th. 荣耀把这项服务与演唱会拍摄结合：手机负责成像和防抖，外接增距镜提供更长焦段。材料列出的 Magic9 Pro Max 影像配置包括双 2 亿像素影像、CIPA 8.0 防抖，以及 200mm 和 500mm 增距镜配件。肖战同时担任荣耀手机代言人，本次南京巡演的第二场安排在 10 月 25 日。

item.title: 雷鸟推 BLG 联名 AR 眼镜，承诺战队不夺冠可退款不退货
item.guid: 雷鸟推-BLG-联名-AR-眼镜，承诺战队不夺冠可退款不退货
item.description:
Thunderbird Innovation and Bilibili launched the GT Max bilibili Limited Edition AR glasses, and initiated the 'BLG doesn't win the championship, Thunderbird fully refunds' event around the League of Legends S16 World Championship. According to the rules announced by the brand, users who purchase this limited edition at Thunderbird's official flagship store during the event period can apply for a full refund and keep the product if BLG ultimately does not win the championship. 雷鸟创新与哔哩哔哩推出 GT Max bilibili 限定版 AR 眼镜，并围绕《英雄联盟》S16 世界赛发起「BLG 不夺冠・雷鸟全退款」活动。按品牌公布的规则，活动期内在雷鸟官方旗舰店购买该限定版的用户，若 BLG 最终未夺冠，可申请全额退款，并保留商品。

The co-branded gift box includes custom GT Max glasses, a custom sunshade, and a BLG-themed Bilibili Super Member quarterly card. The brand announced that the final price after stacked discounts and national subsidies is 2294 yuan. 联名礼盒包含定制 GT Max 眼镜、定制遮光罩，以及 BLG 主题哔哩哔哩超级大会员季卡。品牌公布的叠加优惠及国补后到手价为 2294 元。

GT Max features a 59° field of view, supports a 120Hz refresh rate and 3DoF fixed screen mode; when fixed mode is enabled, the virtual screen can remain in a set position, reducing晃动 caused by head rotation. The glasses also serve as the designated smart glasses for the BLG team, used for reviewing matches and training debriefs. GT Max 采用 59° 视场角，支持 120Hz 刷新率和 3DoF 画面固定模式；开启固定模式后，虚拟画面可保持在设定位置，减少随头部转动产生的晃动。眼镜也作为 BLG 战队指定智能眼镜，用于回看比赛和训练复盘。

item.title: 红果短剧上线休息与睡眠提醒，让剧中角色劝用户放下手机
item.guid: 红果短剧上线休息与睡眠提醒，让剧中角色劝用户放下手机
item.description:
According to Jiemian News, Hongguo Short Drama has launched two mechanisms: 'rest reminder' and 'sleep reminder'. After continuously watching dramas for a certain period, a 'It's time to rest' prompt will appear above the playback page, and the recommendation page may also show reminder videos featuring short drama characters, advising users to temporarily put down their phones. 据界面新闻报道，红果短剧上线「休息提醒」和「睡眠提醒」两项机制。连续看剧达到一定时长后，播放页上方会出现「是时候休息下啦」提示，推荐页也可能刷到由短剧角色出镜的提醒视频，劝用户暂时放下手机。

'Sleep reminder' targets users who are still watching dramas late at night, also prompting them to rest through videos and other means. Both mechanisms are gradually covering more users, and reminders will appear in viewing and recommendation scenarios. 「睡眠提醒」面向深夜仍在看剧的用户，同样通过视频等方式提示休息。两项机制正在逐步覆盖更多用户，提醒会出现在观看和推荐场景中。

item.title: One Fun Thing｜把 355 件 Game Boy 藏品做成一盘百科卡带
item.guid: One-Fun-Thing｜把-355-件-Game-Boy-藏品做成一盘百科卡带
item.description:
After inserting the cartridge into the Game Boy, what appears on the screen is a text museum about this handheld console. Collector Marcel Pflug compiled 355 items and a small encyclopedia into a ROM: users can browse by theme, search across directories, and even bookmark desired items, with records saved by the cartridge battery. 把卡带插进 Game Boy 后，屏幕上出现的是一座关于这台掌机的文字博物馆。收藏者 Marcel Pflug 将自己整理的 355 件藏品和一部小型百科做进 ROM：用户可以按主题翻阅、跨目录搜索，还能给想找的藏品加书签，靠卡带电池保存记录。

Each collection item also has a QR code; scanning the handheld screen with a phone opens the complete entry and photos on a website. These QR codes were pre-generated on a PC and written into the ROM; to adapt to the Game Boy's screen limitations, Pflug split each code into 16 types of repeating tiles. The main text can display about 8 lines per screen, with about 30 characters per line, and the fullest page used 251 out of 255 available tiles. 每件藏品还有一个二维码，用手机扫描掌机屏幕，就能打开网站上的完整条目和照片。这些二维码事先在 PC 上生成并写入 ROM；为适应 Game Boy 的画面限制，Pflug 把每个码拆成 16 种重复图块。正文每屏约能放 8 行、每行约 30 个字符，最满的一页用了 255 个可用图块中的 251 个。

Version 1.0 of this encyclopedia cartridge was released in September this year. The official release provides a free ROM, which can be run on a real Game Boy via a compatible flash cart, or opened directly in a browser. 这盘百科卡带的 1.0 版已于今年 9 月公开。官方提供免费 ROM，可通过兼容烧录卡在真实 Game Boy 上运行，也能直接在浏览器里打开。

item.title: 周末看什么｜《流人》第六季，失意特工对抗机构内部的腐坏
item.guid: 周末看什么｜《流人》第六季，失意特工对抗机构内部的腐坏
item.description:
Slough House in 'Slow Horses' is the department where MI5 places disgraced agents. Gary Oldman's Jackson Lamb is bad-tempered and sharp-tongued, leading a group of people sent here due to professional blunders, constantly clashing with the power struggles of intelligence agencies while solving cases. This black comedy spy drama is adapted from Mick Herron's novel, with its sixth season premiering on Apple TV on September 16th and now having concluded. 《流人》里的斯劳屋，是英国军情五处安置失意特工的部门。Gary Oldman 饰演的 Jackson Lamb 脾气暴躁、言辞刻薄，带着一群因职业失误被打发到这里的人，在办案时不断撞上情报机构的权力斗争。这部黑色幽默间谍剧改编自 Mick Herron 的小说，第六季于 9 月 16 日在 Apple TV 开播，目前已播完。

New Yorker critic Inkoo Kang, in her season finale review, believes that the recent two seasons have made the work more relevant to reality: investigations initially pointing to foreign spies or domestic terrorists often end up exposing government bureaucrats who create chaos for personal gain. The sixth season revolves around Westminster elites and Russian money, with chases, explosions, and office power plays running in parallel; she believes the series retains the tight pace of a spy thriller and continues to portray these characters' individual searches for redemption. 《纽约客》评论人 Inkoo Kang 在季终剧评中认为，近两季让作品更有现实针对性：调查最初指向外国间谍或国内恐怖分子，最终却常常牵出为个人利益制造混乱的政府官僚。第六季围绕西敏寺权贵与俄罗斯资金展开，追杀、爆炸与办公室里的利益交换并行；她认为剧集保留了间谍惊悚的紧凑节奏，也继续书写这群人各自寻找救赎的过程。

item.title: 买书不读指南｜《克拉拉与太阳》，从人工朋友的目光看人类的承诺
item.guid: 买书不读指南｜《克拉拉与太阳》，从人工朋友的目光看人类的承诺
item.description:
Klara is a solar-powered 'Artificial Friend' designed specifically to accompany children. In Kazuo Ishiguro's novel 'Klara and the Sun,' she sits by a shop window, observing passersby and children who come to choose, waiting for someone to take her away; when an opportunity to change her fate arises, she is also reminded not to trust human promises too much. 克拉拉是一位专为陪伴儿童而设计的太阳能「人工朋友」。在石黑一雄的小说《克拉拉与太阳》中，她坐在商店橱窗边，观察来往行人与前来挑选的孩子，等待有人把自己带走；当改变命运的机会出现时，她也被提醒，不要过分相信人类的承诺。

The novel entrusts the narration to this observant robot, allowing her to understand humanity through people's actions, words, and relationships. The original publisher listed love and promises as core themes of the work; the artificial companionship relationship forms the story's setting, and how people express emotions also enters Klara's observations. The simplified Chinese edition was translated by Song Qian and published by Shanghai Translation Publishing House in April 2021. 小说把叙述交给这位观察细致的机器人，让她从人的动作、话语与相互关系中理解人类。原版出版社将爱与承诺列为作品的核心问题；人工陪伴关系构成了故事的设定，人与人如何付出感情也进入克拉拉的观察。简体中文版由宋佥翻译，上海译文出版社于 2021 年 4 月出版。

item.title: 游戏推荐｜《Dreadline Express》，用卡牌解开末日列车的乘客谜团
item.guid: 游戏推荐｜《Dreadline-Express》，用卡牌解开末日列车的乘客谜团
item.description:
'Dreadline Express' places survivors on a train in an apocalypse. Players move through carriages, talk to passengers, collect found cards into an album, and then use them to unlock items, paths, and character stories. Different combinations and choices will change the direction of exploration, and passengers may become allies or enemies. 《Dreadline Express》把幸存者安置在末日里的一列火车上。玩家穿过车厢、与乘客交谈，把找到的卡牌收入卡册，再利用它们解锁道具、路径和人物故事。不同的组合与选择会改变探索方向，乘客也可能成为盟友或敌人。

Czech developer David Konecny said in a Deadline interview that this is a psychological horror game where players do not die. The pressure comes from judging clues, deciding who to sacrifice, and how to deal with the passengers' fates; he led the design and development for the project, with collaborators responsible for art and audio. The game uses PS1-style low-resolution graphics, presenting horror through angular characters and sparse environments. 捷克开发者 David Konecny 在 Deadline 访谈中说，这是一款玩家不会死亡的心理恐怖游戏。压力来自线索判断、牺牲谁以及如何处理乘客的命运；他为项目主导设计与开发，另有协作者负责美术和音频。游戏采用 PS1 风格的低分辨率画面，以棱角分明的人物和留有空白的场景呈现恐怖感。

The game is published by Shoreline Games and launched on Steam on October 16th, supporting Windows. As of press time, all Steam reviews are 'Overwhelmingly Positive,' with 97% of 127 user reviews being positive. The official simplified Chinese store page still uses the English name and notes that the Chinese description on the page is a temporary machine translation. 游戏由 Shoreline Games 发行，10 月 16 日登陆 Steam，支持 Windows。截稿时 Steam 全部评测为「特别好评」，127 篇用户评测中有 97% 为好评。官方简体中文商店页仍沿用英文名，并注明页面中文介绍是临时机器翻译。
